calls.title: Deel Consolidation Discussion
calls.summary: The team convened to finalize the commission structure and onboarding process for a new Account Executive (AE) starting on February 16, 2024. Jennifer Pham-Le confirmed that the commission should align with the fiscal quarter beginning February 1, and Allison Stitt emphasized using the start date as the commission effective date. The commission plan will provide full earnings in the first quarter, with a review of percentages planned. A negotiated deposit for onboarding was reduced to approximately $30,000 to $38,000, which aligns with salary and aims to ease cash flow concerns. Onboarding is contingent upon deposit payment and contract approval, which will take about four business days for any changes. The team also discussed improving contract templates to streamline future hires and emphasized the necessity for clear communication among teams, particularly given time zone challenges.
calls.keywords: Ramp Commission, Customer Success Manager (CSM), Variable Compensation, Deposit Amount, Contract Approval, Onboarding Timeline

calls.title: Deel + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion centered on adopting GrowthBook to replace Amplitude for unified analytics and improved experimentation performance. Dmitry emphasized the need to consolidate event data in Snowflake and improve self-service capabilities, as current performance issues with Amplitude's SDK hinder mobile app functionality. The meeting outlined expectations for doubling the volume of experiments while addressing funnel analytics, which will enhance revenue attribution. Pricing considerations for GrowthBook's enterprise model were reviewed, detailing a substantial annual fee and user costs while suggesting a preference for self-hosting. Technical integration with existing systems like Walker S and the necessary infrastructure were also discussed, setting the stage for a decision by the end of the quarter.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation, self-hosted, pricing model, performance, funnels
